title: doctor.json
description: Drift findings in .standards/doctor.json. Written by doctor, which edits nothing.

standards_path.description: Repo-relative path of the standards folder checked.

checked_at.description: When the check ran, in RFC 3339 form.

commit.description: The target repo's HEAD commit at check time.

commits.description: Non-merge commits scanned for the lens-never-fires check. Default 50.

findings.description: One entry per problem. Empty when nothing drifted.

check.description: glob-matches-nothing: a § glob matches no tracked file. glob-too-broad: a § glob matches more than 25% of the tracked files of its kind. cited-file-gone: an evidence path is no longer tracked. lens-never-fires: no commit in the window triggered the lens. prune-missing: no prune.json. prune-stale: a harness's default model differs from the one recorded in prune.json. section-incomplete: a § lacks its why, 3 evidence lines, or its confirmed-when bar. index-mismatch: an index line links to a missing file, or a § file has no index line.

section.description: The § the finding is about, or null for folder-wide findings.

path.description: The glob, cited path or file the finding names.

fix.description: The command or edit that resolves it, such as rerun prune for §3.1.
